description:
Whether a stop-loss would have helped, measured. The same buy of a coin, held 30, 90, 365 or 730 days, with a stop 5, 10, 15, 20 or 30% below the entry and without one, started on every day of the history. The stop fires on the day's low, not its close, and fees are charged to both. You get how often it fired, how often it sold a buy that would have ended in profit, and the worst case of each. Spot tape, dead coins included.

Use when asked whether a stop-loss protects a spot buy-and-hold. For leveraged positions, where liquidation is the stop, use leverage_survival; for a rule with a stop and a take-profit, strategy_grid_lookup.

inputSchema.description: The coin, how long you meant to hold, and the stop.

coin.description: Ticker or full pair. An unknown one comes back with the list we hold and the ones left out.

stop.description: How far below the entry, in percent: 5, 10, 15, 20 or 30. 0.05 is read as 5.

name: stop_loss_check

outputSchema.description: What the stop did to every possible buy, next to holding.

buys.description: Start days tested. Fewer than 120 and we refuse to give a percentage.

fired_but_would_have_ended_in_profit.description: Buys the stop sold that, held to the end, would have ended in profit after fees. The half nobody shows.

fired_but_would_have_ended_in_profit_pct.description: The same as a share of ALL buys.

mean_without_stop_pct.description: Average buy, holding. Skewed by a few huge winners.

median_days_to_fire.description: Among the buys it fired on. Null when it never fired.

median_without_stop_pct.description: Middle buy, just holding. The alternative, always.

model.description: The assumptions, stated: the low triggers, fills at the stop or the gap open, out until the end, same costs both ways.

ok.description: false when we do not hold that data. Never a zero standing in for an answer.

p05_with_stop_pct.description: Fifth percentile, with the stop: what the stop actually buys.

reason.description: Why, in one sentence, and what we do have instead.

share_in_profit_with_stop_pct.description: Share of buys that ended up, stop.

source.description: The public file these numbers come from.

stop_beat_holding.description: Buys on which the stop ended strictly ahead of holding.

stop_beat_holding_pct.description: The same as a share of buys.

stop_fired.description: Buys on which the stop fired. A count.

stop_fired_pct.description: The same as a share of buys.

worst_with_stop_pct.description: The single worst buy, with the stop. Worse than the stop itself only when a day gapped through.

title: Stop loss check
